title.narrative: Contributing to building a rights-based social protection system in Lebanon and consolidating social assistance for the most vulnerable

description.narrative: Overall Objective/Impact: People in Lebanon, including vulnerable groups, have improved access to social protection through a strengthened national social protection system. The project will entail investing in system and policy level interventions leading to implementation of the NSPS (Outcome 1) while at the same time responding to the needs of vulnerable refugees and Lebanese under the National Disability allowance scheme (Outcome 2).
